answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 45837 Country: India Title: can women take fathwa Question: I wanted to know that can woman take a fatwa on talaq or it can only be given by husband. Answer ID: 45837 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 941/743/B=1434) As per the Islamic Shariah, only man has the right to give talaq. If a woman gives talaq, no talaq shall take place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
